canonical_abstract: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison or an evaluation defect. We preregistered two studies of where these gains come from, with three models of 1.7B to 8B parameters and with Qwen3-14B, and report all 65 primary endpoints. Turning thinking off raised accuracy over a capped thinking setting in 7 of 12 model-benchmark cells, each time mostly through questions the capped setting left without a readable answer. For the small models, the thinking-off setting was not meaningfully worse than a rescue configuration in 7 of 9 cells, nor, for the 1.7B model, than four GEPA-selected harnesses. At 14B, two GEPA harnesses beat it by 30 to 34 points on the LongevityBench letter tasks; in descriptive analyses they were not detectably above the strongest constant-label baseline and answered"Yes"in 95% to 99% of their parsed mortality answers. From a start capped at 64 tokens, GEPA repaired the 1.7B model's harness, but at 14B no proposal of either search scored above zero. Replication through the same pipeline reproduced a defect's distortion in 9 of 20 evaluable cases, 7 of them cases in which the distortion is fixed by an identity of the design. Descriptively, relative to its base model, longevity fine-tuning raised a 1.7B model's letter accuracy by 41 points and cut its MMLU-Pro and GSM8K accuracy by 16 and 63 points; on a second GPU, 58% of its zero-temperature token sequences changed and none of the nine grid verdicts we rechecked did.

official_v1_abstract: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, reasoning switches, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison, or a defect in the evaluation. We preregistered a study of where these gains come from, with three small models, three benchmarks, replication and test partitions, a GEPA search arm and six evaluation defects injected one at a time, and we report all 47 primary endpoints. Turning thinking off raised accuracy over a capped thinking setting in 5 of 9 model-benchmark cells, and in each the gain came mostly from questions where the capped setting gave no readable answer. The thinking-off setting was not meaningfully worse than a rescue configuration or four GEPA-selected harnesses in 11 of 13 comparisons, and lost to the rescue on GSM8K for two models. GEPA repaired its broken starting points, but none of its selected harnesses was more accurate than the thinking-off setting. A thinking budget in the serving engine, which also allows a longer answer, lowered truncation and raised the parse rate in 6 of 9 cells. In 6 of 15 evaluable defect-model pairs, replication through the same pipeline reproduced the defect’s distortion instead of revealing it. On the LongevityBench multiple-choice tasks, only the longevity-tuned model beat the strongest constant-label baseline.
